mapper.select: SELECT total_person_access AS totalPersonAccess, total_visitor_arrive AS totalVisitorArrive, total_vehicle_access AS totalVehicleAccess, space_use_rate AS spaceUseRate, pay_income AS payIncome FROM access_cycle_report WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = FALSE

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(access_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, SUM(CASE WHEN verify_type = '人脸' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS personCount, SUM(CASE WHEN verify_type = '访客' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS visitorCount FROM access_record WHERE deleted = FALSE AND access_time >= (SELECT start_time FROM access_cycle_report WHERE id = #{id}) AND access_time <= (SELECT end_time FROM access_cycle_report WHERE id = #{id}) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(access_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY date

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(access_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, SUM(CASE WHEN access_status = '进场' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS inCount, SUM(CASE WHEN access_status = '出场' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS outCount FROM access_record WHERE deleted = FALSE AND access_time >= (SELECT start_time FROM access_cycle_report WHERE id = #{id}) AND access_time <= (SELECT end_time FROM access_cycle_report WHERE id = #{id}) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(access_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY date
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, space_use_rate AS useRate FROM access_cycle_report WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = FALSE

SELECT access_area AS area, COUNT(*) AS count FROM access_record WHERE deleted = FALSE AND access_time >= (SELECT start_time FROM access_cycle_report WHERE id = #{id}) AND access_time <= (SELECT end_time FROM access_cycle_report WHERE id = #{id}) GROUP BY access_area ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT access_area AS parkName, COUNT(*) AS count FROM access_record WHERE deleted = FALSE AND access_area LIKE '%停车场%' AND access_time >= (SELECT start_time FROM access_cycle_report WHERE id = #{id}) AND access_time <= (SELECT end_time FROM access_cycle_report WHERE id = #{id}) GROUP BY access_area ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT verify_type AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM access_record WHERE deleted = FALSE AND access_time >= (SELECT start_time FROM access_cycle_report WHERE id = #{id}) AND access_time <= (SELECT end_time FROM access_cycle_report WHERE id = #{id}) GROUP BY verify_type ORDER BY value DESC

SELECT '小客车' AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM access_record WHERE deleted = FALSE AND access_time >= (SELECT start_time FROM access_cycle_report WHERE id = #{id}) AND access_time <= (SELECT end_time FROM access_cycle_report WHERE id = #{id})

SELECT pay_type AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM parking_payment WHERE deleted = FALSE AND pay_time >= (SELECT start_time FROM access_cycle_report WHERE id = #{id}) AND pay_time <= (SELECT end_time FROM access_cycle_report WHERE id = #{id}) GROUP BY pay_type ORDER BY value DESC

SELECT 120.0 + RAND() * 2.0 AS lon, 30.0 + RAND() * 1.0 AS lat, FLOOR(1 + RAND() * 100) AS count FROM access_record WHERE deleted = FALSE AND access_time >= (SELECT start_time FROM access_cycle_report WHERE id = #{id}) AND access_time <= (SELECT end_time FROM access_cycle_report WHERE id = #{id}) LIMIT 20

SELECT 120.0 + RAND() * 2.0 AS lon, 30.0 + RAND() * 1.0 AS lat, CONCAT('浙A', LPAD(FLOOR(RAND() * 100000), 5, '0')) AS plateNo FROM access_record WHERE deleted = FALSE AND access_time >= (SELECT start_time FROM access_cycle_report WHERE id = #{id}) AND access_time <= (SELECT end_time FROM access_cycle_report WHERE id = #{id}) LIMIT 30
